title: ELISA Protocol: Dilution Step
author: Opentrons
materials: This is the first part of a ELISA protocol: Dilution Procedure. The robot will perform serial dilutions samples located in the Opentrons 2 mL Eppendorf tube rack in the 1.2 mL tube plates. User will need to upload a CSV specifying the desired concentrations of each sample to be transferred to a separate 96-well plate in part 2 of the protocol. See more information on the CSV requirement in Additional Notes below. Download full protocol details [here](https://s3.amazonaws.com/opentrons-protocol-library-website/custom-README-images/1464-natrix-separations-inc-milliporesigma/NEW_ELISA_protocol.xlsx). --- You will need: * P1000 Single-channel Pipette * P300 Single-channel Pipette * [Opentrons Tube Racks (2 mL Eppendorf)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [Opentrons Tube Rack (15 + 50 mL)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * NEST 2 mL 96-deep well Plate * 96-well Plate * 12-row Trough * 1000 uL Tip Rack * 300 uL Tip Rack
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the ELISA dilution protocol Excel file from the provided link.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists the desired concentration for each sample; this file will be used by the robot for serial dilutions.

steps.title: Upload protocol to App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the deck map, placing the following labware: P1000 single‑channel pipette, P300 single‑channel pipette, Opentrons 2 mL Eppendorf tube rack (with samples in 1.2 mL tube plates), Opentrons 15 + 50 mL tube rack, NEST 2 mL 96‑deep‑well plate, 96‑well plate, 12‑row trough, 1000 µL tip rack, and 300 µL tip rack.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and both pipettes (P1000 and P300) following the app’s calibration procedure.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the robot’s serial dilution of the samples as defined in the CSV.
